card.name: Linking words in trial result sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "in", "and", "is" right after risk, reduction or outcome terms in clinical trial and disease-list text. It also fires on a few stray spots like "predictive" after "prior".

modes.label: Risk or reduction wording
modes.description: The word "of" or "in" after "risk", "reduction" or "outcome", just before a named disease or event.
